olga: Quick callout: ran a tiny canary for rwd-v7-int4; overall perf looks great but a small slice 'billing-invoices' shows coherence drop ~1.4% (sample=620). Need a decision matrix for automatic actions.
marc: Can we require two conditions for hard rollback: slice_mrr_drop >=2% OR (slice_mrr_drop >=1% AND halluc_delta >=0.3pp)? Also enforce min_samples 500.
dez: I like that. Add a time smoothing: average across 3 consecutive windows (10m each) before triggering. For non-critical slices we should only soft-pause.
olga: Proposed short matrix:
- min_samples: 500
- smoothing_windows: 3
- soft: slice_drop >=1% -> pause stepping, spawn shadow, human sample 150
- hard: slice_drop >=2% OR p95_increase >25% OR hallucination >0.5pp -> rollback
- critical_override: for slices in critical_list tighten hard to 1%
sre-bot: alert: canary policy 'decision-matrix-v1' applied to deploy rwd-v7-int4.
marc: also add audit tags on rollback and link to shadow job.
dez: I'll PR to gatebook and include examples. olga: thanks, will hold at 3% until PR lands and we validate windows.
